description: Corsie riservate (TPL) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datigis.comune.fi.it. Linear element containing the network of lanes reserved for local public transport (TPL) in the Municipality of Florence (preferential and rescue lanes), uniquely coded by type, vehicle categories allowed, time slot validity, protection with curbs and / or with telematic doors, reference order. The data shall take into account long-term suspensions. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Reserved lanes (TPL)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tpl, mobilità, open data, corsie riservate. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
